research_question: Did RCEP entry change active relationship persistence differentially with a relationship's pre-policy FactSet revenue percentage?

measurement.source: Relationship episodes beginning no later than 2021-12-31.
measurement.primary_exposure: Maximum valid revenue_percent among the pair-role's qualifying pre-policy episodes, scaled per 10 percentage points.
measurement.valid_range: 0 < revenue_percent <= 100; zero, negative, above-100, and missing values are reported and excluded.
measurement.interpretation_limit: The field is a FactSet quantified relationship percentage, not transaction trade value, contract value, or customs flow.
measurement.coverage_limit: Inference applies only to the selected quantified subset and is not generalized to all relationships.

population.unit: Verified listed Chinese firm-foreign partner-role by year
population.countries: Fourteen RCEP and seven registered Asian non-RCEP economies.
population.cohort_rule: Pair-role must have a valid pre-policy revenue percentage and a first relationship start no later than 2021-12-31.
population.balanced_panel: All eight annual active indicators are retained for every qualifying pair-role.

treatment.preferred: Country-specific timing: 2022 except Indonesia and the Philippines in 2023; never for controls.

secondary: Absorbing survival among links active in 2021
Relationship entry among links inactive in 2021
outcome.selection_rule: Secondary transitions never replace the full quantified cohort based on significance.

estimating_equations.static: Active_pt = alpha_p + lambda_ft + beta Treated_ct + theta(Treated_ct x RevenuePercent10_p) + error_pt
estimating_equations.dynamic: Include cohort-event main effects and their RevenuePercent10 interactions, event time -1 omitted, with the same fixed effects.
estimating_equations.primary_parameter: theta, the differential RCEP response per 10 percentage points of pre-policy quantified relationship revenue.
estimating_equations.randomization_inference: 9,999 unique country timing-label assignments preserving 12 countries in 2022, two in 2023, and seven controls.

identifying_assumption: Conditional on pair-role and firm-year effects and the average country-timing response, high- and low-percentage quantified relationships would not have had different RCEP-versus-control active-status trends absent the policy.

data_gate.pair_support: At least 500 quantified Asian pair-roles, including at least 150 RCEP and 150 controls.
data_gate.country_support: At least ten countries overall and at least four in each treatment group.
data_gate.within_firm_support: At least 30 listed firms with quantified relationships in both treatment groups.
data_gate.outcome_support: At least 100 pair-roles with within-pair active-status variation in each treatment group.
data_gate.exposure_support: Within each treatment group, at least 50 pair-roles lie below and at least 50 at or above the full-sample median positive percentage.
data_gate.failure_rule: Failure stops before pretrend or treatment-effect estimation.

identification_gate.pretrend: Joint test of all cohort-specific RevenuePercent10 lead interactions has p >= 0.10.
identification_gate.economic_threshold: Maximum absolute aggregated RevenuePercent10 lead <= 0.02 probability points per 10 percentage points.
identification_gate.main_effect_check: Cohort-event main effects remain in every dynamic specification; they are not interpreted as a new average RCEP design.
identification_gate.stop_rule: Failure stops before static moderation, bootstrap, randomization, robustness, mechanisms, or heterogeneity.

evidence_gate.positive_result: The interaction has country-label randomization p < 0.05, consistent sign under uniform timing, and no single-country sign reversal.
evidence_gate.inconclusive: Identification passes but the interaction is ordinary under country assignments or too imprecise for 0.02 probability points.
evidence_gate.integrity: No median cutoff, invalid-value rule, episode window, role split, seed, or country is changed after results are inspected.

amendment_rule: Any change after freeze is appended to pap/amendments.md before execution.
